title: install-config.json
description: Written by the Tuna Dive macOS app onto the ESP (<ESP>/tuna-dive/install-config.json) after the user completes the wizard. Consumed once, at first boot, by tuna-dive-agent, which never re-reads it after a successful install.

targetImgref.description: OCI ref to deploy, e.g. ghcr.io/tuna-os/bonito:gnome-asahi. Must resolve to an arm64 bootc image.

rootPartition.description: Block device for the root filesystem, already created by the asahi-installer backend (e.g. /dev/nvme0n1p5).

espPartition.description: Block device for the EFI system partition shared with recoveryOS/m1n1 (e.g. /dev/nvme0n1p1).

filesystem.description: Filesystem to format rootPartition with. zfs is not offered here (fisherman's zfs path assumes whole-disk auto-partitioning, not a pre-made partition).

password.description: Should be a $6$ SHA-512-crypt hash, not plaintext — matches wootc's vault.json convention (hashed in the macOS app before this file is ever written to disk). fisherman's chpasswd step (projectbluefin/fisherman only — see tuna-dive-agent#6) auto-detects a $-prefixed value here and passes chpasswd -e so the hash is stored verbatim rather than re-hashed; a plain string is also accepted (chpasswd hashes it normally) but means the password sat in this file in the clear until the install completed.

wifi.description: Read from the current macOS network by the app (SSID only, per DESIGN.md — never the password); the user re-enters the passphrase on the Mac side and it is written here in the clear for one-shot consumption on tmpfs.

sshEnabled.description: Enables sshd in the bootstrap for the headless/M1-Air-test-loop path (D1).

cosignIdentity.description: Expected cosign certificate identity for targetImgref. When set, tuna-dive-agent verifies the image signature before deploying and refuses to proceed on mismatch.

cosignIssuer.description: Expected cosign OIDC issuer, paired with cosignIdentity.
